C-ADAPTIVE-ACTION-CENTER-V2.IntentSummary: Correct the terminal archive candidate predicate without weakening the strict archive evaluator, add regression coverage for Markdown companions and synchronize the lifecycle contract before archiving the completed Action Center change.

T-001.Title: kafedra-flow-intake: formalize the unreachable terminal lifecycle state

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The exact conflict between the complete companion set, isGovernedPath and archiveCandidate is recorded, and the correction remains limited to terminal lifecycle recognition.

T-002.Title: kafedra-feature: route exact matching active/archive moves to the strict archive evaluator

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: archiveCandidate no longer depends on the global governed classification, while touched IDs, active-at-head and archived spec/plan prerequisites remain unchanged.
evaluateArchiveTransition still receives the complete diff and rejects every path outside the same active/archive bundle.

T-003.Title: kafedra-tests: cover valid companions, mutation, outside writes and archive immutability

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A five-file Markdown companion transition passes, while companion mutation, an outside product write and direct modification of an existing archive each fail with explicit assertions.
Existing active implementation and ObservedWriteScope regression tests remain green.

T-004.Title: kafedra-release: synchronize governance documentation and prove the exact-head gate

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Documentation describes the narrow terminal exception and confirms that normal implementation governance is unchanged.
GRACE final, project, release, database, browser and full-offline CI pass on one immutable head before squash merge.
After post-merge CI a dedicated archive-only PR moves the complete V2 bundle to terminal applied.
